votes.motion: Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township Council meeting held on October 11, 2022
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve Ordinance No. 2022-O-11
Council Member Pierce, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve allocation of $100,000 of ARPA funds to move forward with the intersection realignment project
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to direct Chief Craig to propose the conversion of an investigator position to a sergeant/supervisor, to the SLVLESA Board
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve Resolution 22-11-01 and set the public hearing for December 13, 2022, at 6:00 pm
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve Resolution 22-11-02 and set the public hearing for December 13, 2022, at 6:00 pm
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to set the public hearing to receive comments regarding the 2022 Magna Metro Township Budget Amendments for December 13, 2022, at 6:00 pm
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve the Pleasant Green Cemetery sign design submitted by Aaron Olsen from Unique Welding
Council Member Barney, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the Delay Agreement with PacifiCorp located at 7960 W U201 Highway
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Barney, moved to approve the letter formalizing its participation in the mitigation plan update
